warnings: Pile-cap details of the pile-footing system (S-02 view2). F1-F4 keep element_type 'footing' (same as the plan, spec section 0.4/6b) with footing_type 'pile_cap'; the spread-footing F1-F4 of the other system are on S-09/S-10 and share the marks — a consumer must keep the two systems apart by sheet.
Mats are printed per direction ('9-DB20mm' twice, '7-DB20mm'/'5-DB20mm', '4+4-DB16mm', 'เสริม 3 ทาง ทางละ 8-DB20mm'); main_bar.count = the sum, printed text in count_printed_as (spec 6b).
Cap thickness 0.70 (height_mm) is the concrete only; lean concrete 0.05 and sand 0.05 are in their own fields. D (top of cap to the reference level) is 'ประมาณ 1.50ม.' per the NOTE.
F3 is a triangular cap with cut corners — width_mm/depth_mm hold its base (1.69) and height (1.47); not a rectangle (flag non_rectangular_cap).
F1's extra bars ('4-DB12mm', '8-DB20mm') are recorded as additional_bars with their roles described from the leader lines; low confidence.
